hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad token launchpad. Collects a platform swap fee on registered tokens and splits it between token creators and treasury, with creators optionally directing part of their share into an automatic buyback-and-burn. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the first N blocks after launch and a time-limited sell surcharge on the original deployer address.
